notes.s: A daydream about what one borrowed day with the person he cannot have would look like.
notes.t: Title track of the Skool Luv Affair Special Addition repackage in 2014, from the school trilogy years before anyone outside Korea was watching. Each member takes a turn on what he would do with a single extra day, over a bright funk loop that cuts against how resigned the words are. The rap verse is the part fans came back to later: he admits his dream is the reason he cannot look at her properly, which reads very differently once you know the trainee writing it was about to spend six years on tour. Its morning glory image, a flower that opens and closes inside one day, comes back in Magic Shop four years later with the meaning flipped. It stayed in setlists as the soft spot in an otherwise aggressive early catalogue.
k: 나팔꽃이 필 때 만나, 헤어지자 꽃이 질 때

The morning glory opens at dawn and is finished by afternoon, so naming that specific flower sets the relationship to exactly one day. Magic Shop reuses it in 2018 for the opposite point, ending beautifully rather than ending soon.

A clipped, bookish form of -고 싶다, want to. It lands four times in the first verse (잠들고파, 담그고파, 수영하고파, 알고파) and you will mostly meet it in lyrics and poetry, not in speech, where it sounds old-fashioned or deliberately sweet.

Myeongdong is the most tourist-packed shopping street in Seoul. The English cliche you take my breath away gets made physical by comparing it to being crushed in that crowd. Korean lyrics use Seoul place names as units of intensity like this all the time.

The textbook form is 바라, from 바라다, to hope. Almost every Korean speaker says and writes 바래 anyway, which technically collides with 바래다, to fade. Song lyrics follow the mouth, not the dictionary, so expect 바래 and read it as hope.

vocab.note: Works for alcohol and for being drunk on a person or a smell, same verb
Used for schedules and for stiff mechanisms, not for tight clothing
Sino-Korean, only ever used attributively as 미지의, never on its own
감상하다 is what you do to art or music; a different 감상 means sentimentality
Also means to join forces in business or politics
핑계 대다 is to make an excuse; the noun alone carries the disapproval
Swallowing words you should have said is the standard figure, as here
In dating talk 고백 is specifically the act of telling someone you like them
